characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: Unless the bearer is Shaken, Dispelling Rolls made by the bearer’s army gain a +1 modifier; if the target of an enemy spell is within 18" of the bearer, that modifier is increased to +2.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Channel (1).
The Range of the Wizard’s Learned Spells is increased by 6".
Aura spells gain +3" Range instead, while spells with type Caster are unaffected.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text: In each of the opponent’s Magic Phases, immediately after Excess Magic, the opponent must discard 1 Magic Dice.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: The first time in each Magic Phase that the bearer fails a Casting Roll for a Learned Spell cast with three Magic Dice, the bearer may reroll all Magic Dice.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: The Strength, Armour Penetration, and additional Attack Attributes are defined in brackets (X).

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text: Shots 3, Str as user +1, AP as user +1.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
+1 Att, +1 Str.
During Combat Choices, gain either Flaming Attacks or Lightning Attacks, with Duration: Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: Area Attack (1x5), Direct Hit (Str 6, Multiple Wounds (D3))

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
Can only be used with Longbows and Paired Weapons.
When a unit suffers one or more wounds from attacks with Fae Miasma (before any saves are taken), all models in the unit suffer a −1 to-hit modifier (both for Shooting Attacks and Melee Attacks), with Duration: One Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The target gains two Protection Tokens, which are removed when the spell ends. When a friendly unit within 18" of the target suffers a wound, after Armour Saves have been taken, but before any Special Saves are taken, the target may discard a Protection Token and ignore the wound applying the following rules: [leftmargin=*]
  • Rank-and-File models of Height 1 ignore up to two wounds per token (provided they are suffered simultaneously).
  • Characters, and models of Height 4 or 5, can each only ignore a single wound per phase.
  • Wounds from attacks with Multiple Wounds are not ignored: they inflict one less wound instead.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The Phoenix model part gains Flaming Attacks, Grind Attack (D6, Str 4, AP 1, Flaming Attacks, Unmodifiable), and Sweeping Attack ((XD3*)+1, Str 4, AP 1, Flaming Attacks).
* X is the number of Ranks in the target unit.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Resolute and Strider (Water Terrain).
If the models unit contains a model that already has Resolute from another source, the unit is considered to have two additional Proper Ranks instead of one.
The bearer also gains Lightning Attacks and, if using a Longbow, Stand and Shoot.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Afflict (−2 Def, −2 Off, and −2 Agi), Fearless, Magical Attacks, and Supernal.

characteristics.name: Armour Enchant
characteristics.$text:
Aegis (3+).
The wearer’s Armour is set to 1 and can never be improved beyond this.
If the wearer Miscasts and suffers Witchfire, the number of hits are halved (rounding fractions up) for the wearer and its unit.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model gains First Strike (+1 Def, +1 Off) and Sword Sworn.
While joined to a unit containing Sword Masters, the model's unit benefits from +1 Agi.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model part's gains Devastating Charge (+2 Att), and its unit’s Charge Range rolls gain Maximised.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If the model is without Mount, it gains +1 Arm, which is improved to +2 Arm against Shooting Attacks.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Master of Spellcrafting and Wizard Conclave (3).

The model has these spells available: Altered Sight, Favour of Meladys, Fountain of Youth, Living Steel, Mind Fog, Predator’s Instinct, and Whispers of the Veil.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The Wizard’s Learned Spells have their Casting Value reduced by 1, to a minimum Casting Value of 6.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
Can only be used with Longbows without Weapon Enchantments.
The attack gains Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks, and its Strength is set to 4.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
Devastating Charge (+1 Att), Divine Attacks, and Lethal Strike.
One use only. May be used during Combat Choices: the wielder counts as Charging for the purpose of Devastating Charge, with Duration: Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Flaming Attacks, Metal Armour, and the model part’s Armour is set to 2.
The model replaces its available Paths of Magic with Alchemy and Pyromancy, and ignores the Missile, Damage spell Types for Learned Spells when targeting units that are Engaged in Combat with itself.

characteristics.name: Armour Enchant
characteristics.$text:
+3 Def, +3 Arm, and Attached.
The model’s Armour can never be improved beyond 5.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The bearer gains First Strike (+1 Att, +1 Off) and the bearer's unit may reroll failed Charge Range rolls.

If the model has Height 5, Regal Dragons and Ancient Dragons replace their Ancient Allies (2) rule with Ancient Allies (1), and Phoenixes replace Ancient Allies (1) with Ancient Allies (2).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The model’s Longbow Shots are set to 3, and the model’s unit gains Accurate.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
When the model loses its last Health Point, unless it is a Summoned model, the owner must roll a D6. On a 5+, it is a success — apply the following effects:
  • Before removing the model as a casualty, mark the centre of its final position.
  • At the start of the next friendly Movement Phase, Summon a new Phoenix within 3" of the marked point.
The Summoned model has the same upgrades as the original Phoenix.
Immediately after being Deployed, the model loses 4 Health Points, which cannot be prevented nor Recovered in any way. If the roll is failed, the model is removed as a casualty as normal.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The model must take Great Weapon and cannot take Shield.
The model gains Lion’s Fur, Valiant, and the bearer gains Multiple Wounds (2, towards Height 4--5).
While joined to a unit containing Lion Guards, the model's unit benefits from Swiftstride.

characteristics.name: Potions and Scrolls
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: Round of Combat.
Choose a Magic Item from an enemy unit that is in contact with the bearer. This Magic Item is ignored.
Note: If it was an Enchanted Weapon or Enchanted Shield, the mundane effects of the Weapon or Shield can still be used.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text:
Quick to Fire
A Character with Sky Sloop gains:

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
+1 Str, +2 AP.
Each successful to-hit roll with this weapon causes one additional hit (usually this means it causes two hits instead of one). This additional hit is allocated towards the same target.

characteristics.name: Armour Enchant
characteristics.$text:
+1 Arm, which is improved to +2 Arm for models without Mount.
The bearer can never be wounded on a roll better than 3+.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: Standard Melee Attacks with a Great Weapon ignore Distracting and Parry.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: A unit containing Valiant automatically passes Panic Tests caused by Terror.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text:
A unit with one or more War Banners of Rymâ gains +1" Cha.
In addition, Rank-and-File model parts with Elf in the unit gain Devastating Charge (+1 Str).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains +1 Discipline, Disciplined, and passes its Rebirth roll on 3+ instead of 5+.
The Phoenix model part gains Mount, and the model gains an additional model part:
